fallos_mitigaciones: 2-hop subgraph traversal through high-degree hub nodes (e.g. 'User') introduces 'Semantic Drift' noise into retrieval; mitigated by restricting expansion to L=1 hop (Table 7, sensitivity analysis, §4.7.1).
cita: Choi et al. (2026). G-Long: Graph-Enhanced Memory Management for Efficient Long-Term Dialogue Agents.
notes: mem_tipos EPISODICA;SEMANTICA: persona-driven triplets from dialogue events+persona attributes via PersonaExt (§3.2). representacion GRAFO;VECTOR: 'dual-storage strategy...dense vector indexing for entity nodes and attribute-rich edge storage' (§3.3). operaciones=WRITE only (triplet extraction per utterance, §3.2); trigger EVENTO-DETERMINISTA (extraction runs for each utterance). retrieval EMBEDDINGS;GRAFO;RANKING: anchor-node cosine similarity + 1-hop subgraph expansion + two-stage hybrid rerank Sfinal (§3.4, Eq.4). mide_lectura=SI: Recall@3/5, Accuracy@3/5 on LME (Table 4/5, +40.8% recall vs LD-Agent). benchmarks MSC/CC/LoCoMo/LME (§4.1.1). metricas OTRA (BLEU/ROUGE/G-Eval/Recall/MRR) + COSTO-TOKENS ($1.56 vs $7.61 = 4.9x cheaper, 63.0% token reduction vs Long-Context, Table 6). handoff=CONTENIDO: graph triplets persist across dialogue sessions and are injected as context (MLong) into future-session prompts (§3.5). alcance=SESION (multi-session MSC/CC/LoCoMo).

fallos_mitigaciones: Isotropic cosine retrieval suffers hubness (a few 'hub' memories dominate nearest-neighbor lists, drowning peripheral facts), mitigated by a locally adaptive Fisher-Rao/Mahalanobis metric (§3.2). Naive global token-dropping shatters syntax; mitigated by hierarchical sentence-level distillation + structural protection masks (§3.3-3.4, ablated in Table 5).
cita: Chen et al. (2026). CoreMem: Riemannian Retrieval and Fisher-Guided Distillation for Long-Term Memory in Dialogue Agents.
notes: mem_tipos EPISODICA: 'historical memory set M' of past dialogue turns in an edge-cloud pipeline (§3.1). representacion VECTOR: dense embeddings in a local vector store memory bank (Fig.1, 'Knowledge and Memory'). operaciones=WRITE (embeddings added to bank, no explicit consolidation/eviction of the store itself); trigger EVENTO-DETERMINISTA (implicit per-turn embedding, no explicit admission gate). retrieval EMBEDDINGS;RANKING: Riemannian Fisher-Rao/Mahalanobis retrieval + residual cosine-Riemannian fusion score (§3.2, Eq.2, alpha=0.5). mide_lectura=SI: Hit@k retrieval accuracy (Table 2, H@10 0.532) and structural ablation H@1/H@10 (Table 5). metricas OTRA (ROUGE-L, LLM-Judge accuracy, Hit@k) + COSTO-TOKENS (PTok prompt-token counts Table 2/3; FDTD compresses prompts 20-30%, abstract) + LATENCIA (Time(s) wall-clock, Table 2/3). evidencia_tipo ABLATION (Table 5 structural ablation; embedding-model ablation §5.1) + BENCHMARK-E2E (Table 2/3) + MEDICION-COSTO (8GB VRAM ceiling profiling §5.6; ~20% API cost reduction, Fig.1 caption). handoff=CONTENIDO: the compressed distilled context X-tilde transmitted to the cloud LLM carries facts forward across the ongoing multi-session history. alcance=SESION (multi-session dialogue, 'dozens of sessions').

fallos_mitigaciones: Naive FIFO/recency eviction drops load-bearing state (e.g. an auth token or a path a later step needs), causing agents to loop or fail (Fig.1-2). LLM-based compression (ACON) paraphrases and loses exact identifiers, also causing loops. Both mitigated by LRE's verbatim, query-blind, learned-relevance retention (§5.1-5.2: 14 tasks solved only by LRE, Table 10/11).
cita: Lia and Mazumder (2026). Learning What Not to Forget: Long-Horizon Agent Memory from a Few Kilobytes of Learning.
notes: mem_tipos TRABAJO;EPISODICA: in-context history units are dialogue turns or agent action-observation steps managed under a token/unit budget (§3.1), i.e. working-memory/context eviction over episodic content, not a persisted long-term store. representacion DOCS-ARCHIVOS: units are kept 'verbatim' as plain text (§3.1, 'nothing is summarized or rewritten'); the feature vector phi(ui) is only a scoring signal, not the stored representation. operaciones=OLVIDO: the paper's entire contribution is a proactive eviction policy (title: 'Learning What Not to Forget'; §1,§3). trigger=PRESUPUESTO: eviction is bound by an explicit token/unit budget B (Eq.1, Table 1: 2048 tokens for agents, unit-count cap for conversation). retrieval=NA: the paper explicitly contrasts eviction from retrieval ('Eviction is different from retrieval...it must decide what to keep before the query...exists', §1) -- LRE is query-blind and does not perform query-time search over stored memory. mide_lectura=SI (correction vs F_screening 'CONSOLIDACION;COSTO': adding RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO to F per rule 3, since the paper explicitly measures read/selection quality): macro-AUC ranking of gold-evidence turns (Table 3, 0.829 LoCoMo, 'A query-blind scorer that rivals dense retrievers') and gold-recall-vs-retention-budget curves (Fig.6, §5.4). alcance=TAREA;SESION (AppWorld agent task-level; LoCoMo/LongMemEvalS conversational session-level). multiagente=NO (explicit limitation: 'not on...collaborative multi-agent systems', §7 Limitations). fidelidad_procedencia=NO: the paper's own use of 'fidelity' (abstract: 'eviction...is a fidelity problem') refers to verbatim-extraction exactness of load-bearing content, not provenance/staleness verification of sources. metricas EXITO (Task Goal Completion %, Table 2) + ITERACION (mean trajectory steps Stp, Table 2) + COSTO-TOKENS (peak tokens Pk; 68% fewer tokens on LoCoMo, §5.4) + OTRA (macro-AUC, gold recall). evidencia_tipo ABLATION (Table 4: self-supervised vs supervised label recovery) + BENCHMARK-E2E (Table 2/3: AppWorld, LoCoMo, LongMemEvalS) + MEDICION-COSTO (Table 13: scores 1,181 units/s vs 103/36 for dense-encoder/LLM-pruner baselines, 11.5x/32.8x faster, CPU-only, ~1.7KB scorer). handoff=CONTENIDO: the verbatim-retained units are precisely what persists/carries forward across the growing multi-session/multi-step history (Fig.2).

fallos_mitigaciones: Append-only memory stores show catastrophic degradation as evidence grows more distant, and systems lacking lifecycle management return stale facts under conflicting updates ('hallucinations of the past', O3/O4, §1). Own finding/mitigation: 'conservative memory consolidation serves as the best default maintenance strategy, whereas delayed flushing creates a deceptive trade-off between surface-level coverage and actual answerability' (O6).

fallos_mitigaciones: Domain/distribution drift of the embedding stream degrades routing quality; mitigated via rolling quantization-error monitoring (alarm at 1.3x baseline) triggering codebook refit (§2.5, H5: recall recovers to 0.92 from a 5K-item domain shift, pre-shift 0.952). Hierarchical routing trades recall for bounded latency; the residual recall gap (up to -9pp at N=1M) is localized to fine-bucket assignment (Table 5) and left unresolved as future work (§5).

notes: Sistema de indexado agnostico al contenido: opera sobre 'items' de texto embebidos genericos via K-means codebook/IVF (§2.1), sin distinguir tipo de memoria episodica/semantica/etc. => mem_tipos=NA. representacion=VECTOR: embeddings densos indexados via IVF (§2.1-2.3). operaciones/trigger=NA: el paper asume un corpus D ya dado (Let D={(ti,ei)}) y no describe mecanismo propio de escritura/admision/consolidacion/olvido de contenido; 'drift detection' (§2.5) es shift estadistico de la distribucion de embeddings/queries, no staleness de contenido. retrieval EMBEDDINGS;RANKING: multi-probe IVF sobre centroides + rerank por dot-product (§2.2) + score-based filtering por umbral tau (§2.4). mide_lectura=SI: R@5/recall@10/purity medidos extensamente (Tabla 1-3, H1-H2, Table 2 MS-MARCO). alcance=NA: infraestructura generica para 'long-lived agents' sin delimitar explicitamente tarea/sesion/proyecto/organizacion (§4.4). fidelidad_procedencia=NO: el 'drift detection' es deteccion de shift de distribucion estadistica, no verificacion de procedencia/staleness de contenido (distincion explicita de rule 7). benchmarks MS-MARCO (§3.3, validacion con encoder real all-MiniLM-L6-v2). metricas OTRA (R@5, recall@10, purity) + LATENCIA (p50/p95/p99 extensivamente reportado, Tablas 1-4) + COSTO-TOKENS (H3: tau=0.6 descarta 31.8% de tokens perdiendo solo 0.9% de recall, §3.1). evidencia_tipo ABLATION (K-sweep, umbral de filtrado, flat-vs-jerarquico, SQLite-vs-mmap: Tablas 3-5) + BENCHMARK-E2E (MS-MARCO con encoder real, Tabla 2) + MEDICION-COSTO (RAM RSS medido, latencia, Tablas 1-4). handoff=NO: arquitectura de indice de recuperacion; no describe un protocolo explicito de traspaso de memoria entre sesiones o agentes (aunque menciona agentes 'long-lived' que acumulan memoria, §4.4).

fallos_mitigaciones: 'Unfiltered memory degrades performance': naive RAG / long-context methods that feed full histories without filtering suffer redundancy and performance drops under edge-device constraints (§4.2). Mitigated by MemDecider, an importance-based admission filter (ablation Table 3: 'All-Accept'/'Random' both degrade performance vs EMA).
cita: Lan et al. (2026). EMA: An Episodic Memory Agent for Efficient and Selective Memory.
notes: mem_tipos=EPISODICA: EMUs (Episodic Memory Units) explicitly modeled on human episodic memory (Tulving, §2), fields id/tau/P/phi/C/s/c/L/x. representacion=HIBRIDA: EMU = structured record (metadata+summary+original content) + semantic embeddings + a link-graph across EMUs ('Memory Linking...forms a structured memory network', §3.3, Fig.2). operaciones=WRITE;ADMISION;CONSOLIDACION;ACTUALIZACION: MemDecider is explicitly an admission gate ('filters memory admission based on information importance', contribution bullet, §3.2); Memory Manager writes/constructs EMUs (WRITE); Self-Update revises stale EMUs (ACTUALIZACION, explicit example: a canceled plan updates the corresponding EMU, §3.3); EMUs Reorganization runs periodic 'global re-embedding and consolidation' (CONSOLIDACION, §3.3). trigger=EVENTO-DETERMINISTA;CHECKPOINT: MemDecider scores every incoming dialogue turn (event-based); reorganization fires 'once the frequency of Memory Linking and Self-Update operations reaches a predefined threshold' (count-based checkpoint, §3.3). retrieval=EMBEDDINGS;RANKING: Caller does NER-augmented query encoding then embedding top-k match against EMU label+summary+links (§3.4). mide_lectura=SI (matches F_screening). fidelidad_procedencia=SI: Self-Update explicitly handles staleness (example: a plan mentioned then canceled triggers an EMU update, §3.3).
